verdict.rationale: Whether a government company registry offers API parity with its web UI is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two probes recording HTTP 403 at robots.txt on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in. Nothing documents any API, let alone one matching the UI's capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
